name: Knight of Piety
body:
You are a paragon of chivalry and holiness, and your dedication to these twin virtues bolsters you in your time of need.

Prerequisite(s): Challenge class feature; Smite Evil class feature

Benefit: You may convert a use of Smite Evil into a Challenge, and a Challenge into a Smite Evil.

Special: You may only possess 1 Knightly feat.
